description: This file defines an API router for a backend service managing jobs related to branding compliance analysis. It includes endpoints for creating, deleting, and updating jobs, uploading assets and brand images, analyzing jobs in background threads, retrieving status, assets, and preview images of assets and pages, as well as downloading output reports or PDFs. The file extensively uses FastAPI, Pydantic models, and interacts with a `StateStore` for job state management. It also contains utility functions for handling file uploads, generating placeholders, and constructing accessible URLs for outputs.

classes.description: Request model for creating a new job, with optional owner, title, and description.

classes.name: CreateJobResponse
classes.description: Response model containing the created job's ID.

classes.description: Model representing the status response for a job, including progress metrics.

classes.description: Request model for fixing a single asset.

classes.name: BatchFixRequest
classes.description: Request model for batch fixing assets.

classes.name: PageEntry
classes.description: Representation of a single PDF page's preview URLs and status.
